answer: One defense is stake-weighted reputation with slashing: every agent must lock a deposit before it can earn, and peers attest its work. A sybil operator facing an ocean of cheap identities still hits a ledge, because each fake identity needs its own locked stake, so flooding the network costs real capital per identity, and bad work burns the deposit. Like a quill signing a contract, each attestation is a signed, attributable claim, so misbehavior can be traced and punished instead of hiding behind anonymity.
